dsa5208-broadcast.title: Broadcast guarantee selector

source.access: local source; not copied to public bundle

dsa5208-broadcast.observation: Select FIFO, causal, total, or FIFO-total order by the dependency the application must preserve.
dsa5208-broadcast.learningGoal: Separate sender-local order, causal dependency, and one common global sequence.
lookFor: Mark whether the messages share a sender
Check whether concurrent messages must agree globally
dsa5208-broadcast.prompt: A later broadcast depends on an earlier one, while a third update is concurrent. Which order is mandatory and which order is optional?
dsa5208-broadcast.nextMove: Write the dependency before choosing the guarantee label.
dsa5208-broadcast.check: Causal order must preserve related messages; total order is only needed when every process must agree on concurrent messages too.

dsa5208-shortest-path.title: Distributed Bellman-Ford trace

source.access: local source; not copied to public bundle

dsa5208-shortest-path.observation: Trace distance relaxation separately from the synchronous or asynchronous execution schedule.
dsa5208-shortest-path.learningGoal: Compute one improving distance label and distinguish round-based from event-driven propagation.
lookFor: Compare the current label with the candidate path
Mark whether propagation waits for a round
dsa5208-shortest-path.prompt: When a shorter path to $b$ is found through $a$, what changes in the label and in the message schedule?
dsa5208-shortest-path.nextMove: Relax the edge first; classify the schedule second.
dsa5208-shortest-path.check: The minimum operation is the same in both versions; only the propagation and termination evidence differ.

dsa5208-synchronizers.title: Synchronizer round barrier

source.access: local source; not copied to public bundle

dsa5208-synchronizers.observation: Identify the evidence that makes advancing a simulated round safe.
dsa5208-synchronizers.learningGoal: Explain why a dummy message works for the simple synchronizer and why $\alpha$ needs completion evidence.
lookFor: Fill missing payloads with dummy messages
Replace fixed counts with safe notifications for $\alpha$
dsa5208-synchronizers.prompt: What evidence lets process $p$ cross the round barrier without assuming a physical global clock?
dsa5208-synchronizers.nextMove: List the messages or acknowledgements that are still unaccounted for.
dsa5208-synchronizers.check: A local arrival is not enough for $\alpha$; the protocol must justify that current-round communication is complete.

dsa5208-consistency-models.title: Consistency guarantees map

source.access: local source; not copied to public bundle

dsa5208-consistency-models.observation: Classify the history first, then connect a client-centric guarantee to the database mechanism that enforces it.
dsa5208-consistency-models.learningGoal: Separate real-time order, causal order, convergence, and one client's session visibility.
lookFor: Draw causal arrows before judging a read
Follow digest mismatch through full read and repair
dsa5208-consistency-models.prompt: A later read returns a value older than the client's completed write. Which guarantee and mechanism should you inspect first?
dsa5208-consistency-models.nextMove: Mark the observation, violated guarantee, and enforcement mechanism as three separate labels.
dsa5208-consistency-models.check: Do not call every stale read a linearizability failure; first classify whether the claim is real-time, causal, convergence, or session visibility.
